definitions.explanation: A periodical published by an academic society or professional association, containing peer-reviewed research papers, reviews, and reports in a specific field.

examples.japanese: {学会誌|がっかいし}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{論文|ろんぶん}→論文：03787_ronbun⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{投稿|とうこう}した→投稿する：18994_toukousuru⟧。
examples.english: I submitted a paper to an academic journal.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{研究|けんきゅう}→研究：01396_kenkyuu⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{学会誌|がっかいし}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{掲載|けいさい}→掲載：08993_keisai⟧⟦された→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: This research was published in an academic journal.

examples.japanese: ⟦{最新|さいしん}→最新：04831_saishin⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{学会誌|がっかいし}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{読|よ}んで→読む：00426_yomu⟧、⟦{自分|じぶん}→自分：02887_jibun⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{分野|ぶんや}→分野：03612_bunya⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{動向|どうこう}→動向：05580_doukou⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{把握|はあく}する→把握する：19628_haakusuru⟧ようにして⟦いる→いる：00495_iru⟧。
examples.english: I make a point of reading the latest academic journals to keep up with trends in my field.

notes:
Composed of ⟦{学会|がっかい}→学会：04139_gakkai⟧ (academic society) + {誌|し} (journal, magazine). Refers specifically to journals published by professional academic organizations, as opposed to commercial or popular science magazines.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {学会誌|がっかいし}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{投稿|とうこう}する→投稿する：18994_toukousuru⟧: to submit to an academic journal
- {学会誌|がっかいし}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{掲載|けいさい}される→掲載する：19217_keisaisuru⟧: to be published in an academic journal
- {学会誌|がっかいし}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{発行|はっこう}する→発行する：19236_hakkousuru⟧: to publish an academic journal
- {学会誌|がっかいし}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{査読|さどく}→査読：08412_sadoku⟧: peer review for an academic journal

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {論文誌|ろんぶんし}: research journal — focuses on papers rather than the society that publishes it
- ⟦{紀要|きよう}→紀要：23252_kiyou⟧: bulletin — institutional publication, often from a university department
- {学術雑誌|がくじゅつざっし}: academic magazine — broader term that includes commercial academic publications
